item.title: Hundi collection of over Rs 3.72 cr recorded at Srisailam
item.description: Srisailam (Nandyal district): The Srisailam Devasthanam recorded a substantial Hundi collection of Rs 3,72,50,251 through the hundi counting conducted on Sunday, January 12, 2026, according to an official press release issued by the Executive Officer’s office. item.title: Adam Sandler vows to make ‘50 more movies’ before he’s ‘dead’, jokes at awards ceremony
item.description: Before receiving the award, Sandler was introduced by his longtime friend, actor and director Henry Winkler. The ceremony celebrates the achievements of creatives over the age of 50 and aims to challenge ageism in the entertainment industry.

item.title: Sara Arjun reveals she signed Telugu debut Euphoria before Dhurandhar came her way
item.description: Sara’s journey in films began very early, with her first screen appearance in a TV commercial at just 18 months old, followed by her cinematic debut at the age of six in the Tamil movie Deiva Thirumagal.

item.title: The real outcome of education is adaptability, not just employability
item.description: As technology continues to reshape industries at an unprecedented pace, the role of engineering education is undergoing a fundamental redefinition. item.description: The potential world tour announcement follows Zayn’s recent week-long Las Vegas residency, scheduled to take place at Dolby Live at Park MGM from 20 to 31 January 2026.

item.title: Sankranti cheer for employees: Govt hikes DA
item.description: Hyderabad: On the occasion of Sankranti festivities, the Telangana government has announced a substantial revision of the Dearness Allowance (DA), benefiting over seven lakh families across the State. Orders to this effect were issued on Monday. item.title: Kishan Reddy pushes rural jobs reforms
item.description: Union Minister Kishan Reddy, addressing a media conference at the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) state office, reiterated the party’s commitment to rural employment reforms and expressed firm confidence in a BJP political resurgence in Telangana. He announced that the central government will organise awareness programmes on the Vikasit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar Aajivika Mission (Gramin)—the VB-G RAM G Act 2025—across all state capitals to strengthen rural livelihoods.
